findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: keyword_search_volume, keywords_for_site, ranked_keywords, keyword_gap, page_intersection, backlinks_list, on_page_audit, pagespeed, google_search, google_maps_search, serp_history, bing_search, youtube_search · Private data: whois_overview · Public sink: keyword_search_volume, tech_stack, whois_overview · Destructive: backlinks_history, pagespeed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: keyword_search_volume, keywords_for_site, ranked_keywords, keyword_gap, page_intersection, backlinks_list, on_page_audit, pagespeed, google_search, google_maps_search, serp_history, bing_search, youtube_search · Private data: whois_overview · Public sink: keyword_search_volume, tech_stack, whois_overview · Destructive: backlinks_history, pagespeed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
